tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Testing is done with self-signed certificates, and HTTPS is used everywhere with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
